_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

segments.text: Hair, air, heart, art. Watch my mouth.
Repeat after me. Hair, air, heart, art.

native.hook: Le H ou pas ? Regarde la bouche !
native.caption: “hair” ou “air” ? “heart” ou “art” ? Avec le H, on souffle un peu d’air avant la voyelle ; sans H, on commence directement. Regarde la bouche d’Ama, puis répète chaque mot pendant le silence. Continue dans l’appli Lexkite.

en.hook: With the H or not? Watch the mouth!
en.caption: “hair” or “air”? “heart” or “art”? With the H, you push a little air out before the vowel; without it, you start right away. Watch Ama’s mouth, then say each word in the pause. Continue in the Lexkite app.
